title: Deadly Russian strikes hammer Kyiv on eve of Trump trip to critical NATO summit
facts: Russian ballistic missiles and drones attacked Ukraine's capital Kyiv early Monday morning on July 6, 2026.
The July 6, 2026 Russian attack on Kyiv killed at least 19 people within the city.
The July 6, 2026 Russian attack killed eight additional people in the surrounding region outside Kyiv.
Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko reported destruction and damage across four districts of the city following the strikes.
The Podilsky district of Kyiv sustained the hardest impact during the July 6, 2026 Russian assault.
A Russian attack on Kyiv on Thursday of the previous week resulted in 30 fatalities.
The UN Human Rights Monitoring Mission in Ukraine stated that civilian casualties in 2026 were significantly higher than during the same period in 2025.
The Ukrainian air force reported that 29 ballistic missiles and 18 attack drones struck 34 locations across the country on July 6.
Russia launched more than 350 drones and 66 missiles toward Ukraine during the July 6 assault.
The July 6 attacks caused power outages in the Kyiv, Sumy, Kharkiv, and Dnipropetrovsk regions of Ukraine.
The Ukrainian military reported striking Russia's largest oil refinery in a long-range attack on July 6, 2026.
The targeted Russian oil refinery is situated more than 2,500 kilometers from the Ukrainian border.
US President Donald Trump and Russian President Vladimir Putin engaged in a nearly 90-minute phone call on Sunday, July 5, 2026.
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky requested that allies supply Ukraine with missiles for Patriot air defense systems.
The state news agency TASS reported that Russia shot down 519 Ukrainian drones overnight into Monday, July 6.
